item.title: 2 dead, 7 injured after Shockoe Bottom shooting in Richmond
item.description: Two people are dead and seven other people were injured after a mass shooting in Richmond's Shockoe Bottom early Saturday morning.

item.title: TSA PreCheck remains open despite shutdown concerns
item.description: The Transportation Security Administration confirmed Sunday that its PreCheck program remains operational, despite earlier reports that the Department of Homeland Security planned to suspend the service as of 6 a.m.

item.title: Memorial service honors fallen Virginia Beach Police officers 1 year later
item.description: Family, friends, police, and city officials gathered to honor the two Virginia Beach Police officers who were killed in the line of duty one year ago, in a memorial service that included a moment of silence, prayers, and words of remembrance.

item.title: One dead, multiple injured after explosion at Perdue facility in Hertford County
item.description: Search and recovery efforts are now underway after an explosion at the Perdue feed facility on Perdue Road in Cofield Saturday morning, according to a representative from the Hertford County Government.
